lines: Let's talk about your first product to know cold — SmartViewz.
SmartViewz is an A.I. intelligence platform built for life and annuity agents.
It turns an agent's messy spreadsheets and data into a clean, living dashboard.
It surfaces revenue insights, flags compliance issues, and answers questions about their book.
Think of it as a smart co-pilot that already understands the insurance business.
Who's it for? Any life or annuity agent drowning in data who wants clarity and time back.
Your pitch is simple: stop guessing, start seeing. SmartViewz shows agents what's really happening.
It's a monthly subscription, so every agent you sign becomes recurring income for you.
Know the problem it solves, and you'll sell it with confidence.
That's SmartViewz. Next up, a product that turns documents into video. Let's go.
